name: Solenoid MIDI Music
summary: Generic USB-MIDI controller concept for 1–128 solenoids with impulse, sustained and PWM velocity modes.
description: An older generic actuator framework covering percussion impulses, sustained note activation and PWM-controlled velocity/hold power. It is useful as a reference for solenoid power-stage patterns and note mapping.

notes: USB MIDI is documented; a final controller board is not asserted in the audited README excerpt.

mechanics.summary: One solenoid maps to one note. Three behaviours are documented: timed percussion impulse, sustained on/off, and PWM velocity/hold-power control.
notes: Supports chromatic or diatonic note mapping in the code design.

actuators.role: Per-note actuation, from 1 up to 128 outputs
actuators.driver: MCP23017/PCA9685 with ULN2803/ULN2804 or MOSFET power stage
actuators.notes: PWM hold-power reduction is described for thermal management.

notes: Solenoid supply and protection must be sized for the selected actuators; flyback protection is required for MOSFET-driven coils.

warnings: Legacy generic controller; use modern PlayMode GMB for new projects unless this reference architecture is specifically needed.
